annotations.summary: A transaction submission to the Starknet gateway was issued but never completed. This is a known upstream defect: the submission has no timeout and can hang indefinitely (equilibriumco/pathfinder#3545). Two such hangs inside one attestation window cost an epoch on Sepolia.
